jobs.title: University Partnerships Team Intern LATAM
jobs.excerpt: At The Intern Group, we believe in the power of potential.
jobs.description:
At The Intern Group, we believe in the power of potential. Our purpose is to inspire and encourage individuals to believe in and challenge themselves, discover their passions, and realize their true potential. Our vision is bold: a world where all 8 billion people can achieve their dreams. We are on a mission to make this vision a reality, aiming to welcome over 10,000 participants to our programs annually by 2030.

We aim to cultivate a future where international internships are a key component of academic journeys, with many participants supported by our scholarship program. This future will empower a new generation—skilled, globally-minded, and ready to lead with understanding and cooperation.

Guided by our core values—people focus, teamwork, continuous learning, and global leadership—The Intern Group has grown from a serendipitous meeting of our Co-Founders in a London pub to becoming the leading provider of international internships, receiving 40,000 applications annually. Join us in shaping the next generation of global leaders.

Does this sound like a place where you can grow? Want to be a part of our journey? Come join our team as:

YOUR IMPACT

Join us in our purpose to inspire the leaders of tomorrow!

We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive, and enthusiastic University Partnerships Intern to join our University Partnerships Team (UPT). You’ll work closely with a global team that manages relationships with 150+ universities and helps students access transformative international experiences.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll support the team across university engagement, alumni ambassador coordination, events, site visits, presentations, and marketing projects. You’ll have the opportunity to work with colleagues and partners around the world while developing practical experience in partnerships, international education, marketing, and project coordination.

The ideal person is someone who enjoys making things happen—someone who is organized, pays attention to detail, follows through on tasks, and can confidently manage multiple projects and deadlines.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the UPT team with day-to-day coordination, projects, research, and administrative tasks that help the team achieve its partnership and enrollment goals.
  • Coordinate Alumni Ambassadors, supporting communication, engagement, scheduling, content collection, and ongoing program activities.
  • Support career fair and conference participation, including logistics, registrations, materials, presentations, meeting schedules, and follow-up.
  • Prepare university presentations and materials, helping the team deliver engaging and professional presentations to university partners and students.
  • Coordinate the logistics of university site visits, including scheduling, itineraries, materials, communication, and follow-up.
  • Support the marketing and distribution of UPT impact reports and other partner-facing materials, working with the marketing team where appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date information, including data clean-up and regular follow-ups, across the CRM, spreadsheets, and other team systems.
  • Support other UPT initiatives and projects as they arise, taking ownership of assigned tasks and ensuring they are completed on time.

YOUR SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

  • A strong interest in international education, university partnerships, marketing, or global business.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • A proactive, positive, and can-do attitude.
  • Strong follow-through—you take ownership and make sure things get done.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating with a global team.
  • Confident using digital tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Canva, or similar platforms.
  • Creative and resourceful, with an interest in creating engaging presentations and partner-facing materials.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, and CRM systems.
  • Previous experience in university, marketing, events, administration, student organizations, or customer-facing roles is a plus.
  • Experience studying, working, or living abroad is a plus.

YOU’LL LOVE WORKING AT TIG BECAUSE

At The Intern Group, we’re passionate about people, their growth, and making an impact. You’ll work alongside a diverse, global team and gain hands-on experience in international education and university partnerships.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Work with a global team and international university partners.
  • Take ownership of meaningful projects from day one.
  • Develop skills across partnerships, events, marketing, project management, and communications.
  • Build an international professional network.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues across different areas of the business.
  • Contribute directly to our mission of inspiring the leaders of tomorrow.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive internship stipend
  • Generous global PTO policy
  • Continuous learning opportunities
  • Access to the Career Advancement Training course and the Keynote Speaker Series
  • The incredible opportunity to meet new people and network with people from all around the world across a wide range of industries.

HOW TO APPLY

We really hope this role has what you’re looking for. If you would like to apply, click on the “Apply for this Job” button above and submit a brief cover letter (addressed to Mr. Taco) telling us a bit about yourself, sharing examples of successful relationship-building experience, along with your resume or CV in English.

The Intern Group is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Intern – Accounting & Finance
jobs.excerpt: The Internal Audit team is seeking a graduate-level intern with a strong accounting and finance background to support financial and operational audit engagements.
jobs.description:
The Internal Audit team is seeking a graduate-level intern with a strong accounting and finance background to support financial and operational audit engagements. This role focuses on evaluating financial processes, controls, and reporting practices while developing a deep understanding of risk management and internal control frameworks.

What You'll Do:

  • Support financial and operational audit engagements, including planning, testing, and documentation
  • Assist in evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls over financial processes
  • Analyze financial data to identify trends, anomalies, and potential risk areas
  • Document business processes and contribute to clear, management-facing audit reports
  • Support advisory projects focused on process improvement and control enhancement

Learning Opportunities

  • Gain exposure to a global enterprise financial environment and end-to-end business processes
  • Understand internal controls, financial risk, and governance frameworks
  • Apply accounting and finance concepts to real-world audit and advisory work
  • Develop professional audit documentation, analysis, and stakeholder communication skills
  • Currently enrolled in a graduate-level program (MBA, MS, or PhD) in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, and business processes
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a professional environment
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Prior exposure to audit, accounting, or financial analysis is a plus
